languages: Python — the entire codebase is Python 3.13. Main package: src/edullm_sat/. Workspace components each under components/<name>/src/. No other non-trivial programming language is present.
user_facing_surfaces: 1. Public HTTP API — FastAPI app entry-point src/edullm_sat/api/app.py, deployed to Cloud Run (POST /generate, GET /browse, GET /health, etc.). 2. GCS bucket browser — served at /browse route (src/edullm_sat/api/routes/browse.py). 3. SVG-to-image HTTP microservice — entry-point components/svg-to-image/src/, listens on port 8002, converts SVG to PNG via POST /convert.
frontend: No browser UI surface. The /browse endpoint serves HTML via Jinja2 templates (src/edullm_sat/templates/) for bucket browsing, but there is no JavaScript framework, no build tool, and no dedicated frontend codebase. The question-viewer workspace component (components/question-viewer/) renders questions as HTML/SVG for viewing, also server-side.
backend_systems: 1. Main FastAPI API server — entry-point src/edullm_sat/api/app.py; triggered by HTTP requests; deployed as a Cloud Run service. 2. SVG-to-image server — entry-point components/svg-to-image/src/ (svg-to-image CLI `serve`); triggered by HTTP requests; runs as a separate process/container. Both are independently deployable. The Dockerfile bundles only the main API server.
backend_systems_unknowns: Whether the svg-to-image server is deployed as a separate Cloud Run service or is expected to run as a sidecar/local process is not specified in deployment config.
system_communication: Main API ↔ SVG-to-image server: REST HTTP (the main API calls svg-to-image's POST /convert endpoint). Main API ↔ LLM providers (Gemini, Anthropic, OpenAI): REST via litellm SDK. Main API ↔ InceptCurriculum API: REST HTTP (services/curriculum.py). Main API ↔ InceptBench API: REST HTTP. Main API ↔ GCS: Google Cloud Storage SDK (direct object read/write). Main API ↔ Langfuse: REST HTTP via langfuse SDK callbacks. No shared-schema DB between services.
persistence: 1. Google Cloud Storage (GCS) — bucket sat-math-api-assets-edullm-491103; schema owned by this repo (objects are generated question assets, SVGs, HTML); main API writes and reads. 2. No relational or document database is used. Supabase is referenced in .env.example (agent_checkins table) for agent check-in observability but there is no application-layer ORM or migrations — it is a lightweight telemetry sink, not a primary datastore.
persistence_unknowns: Supabase check-ins table (CHECKINS_TABLE=agent_checkins) is referenced in env vars and services/orchestrator.py but the scope of writes is unclear (agent tooling vs runtime app path).
auth: Authentication: POST /generate accepts a Bearer token (Authorization header) or X-API-Key header checked against SERVICE_AUTH_TOKEN env var; if unset, the endpoint is open (local dev mode). No session or OAuth flow. Authorization: single flat check in the verify_auth FastAPI dependency (src/edullm_sat/api/routes/generate.py); all other routes are unauthenticated. No row-level security or role-based access.
async_work: No queues, cron jobs, or durable workflows within the application. The generation pipeline uses asyncio.gather for parallel LLM calls (src/edullm_sat/generation/pipeline.py) within a single request, but this is in-request concurrency, not out-of-band async work. CI/CD deploy (GitHub Actions deploy.yml) is triggered by merge to main but is external infrastructure, not application-level async work.
external_integrations: 1. Google Gemini (via litellm) — primary LLM provider for question generation (default model gemini/gemini-3-flash-preview). 2. Anthropic Claude (via litellm) — alternate LLM provider. 3. OpenAI (via litellm) — used by image-gen component for image generation. 4. InceptCurriculum API (api.curriculum.inceptapi.com) — fetches SAT curriculum articles. 5. InceptBench API (api.inceptbench.com) — evaluation/benchmarking integration. 6. Google Cloud Storage — object storage for generated assets. 7. Langfuse (cloud.langfuse.com) — LLM observability and tracing. 8. Supabase — agent check-in telemetry.
unusual: 1. Bundled workspace of six internal Python components (svg-gen, svg-to-image, gcs-uploader, image-gen, question-bank-fetcher, question-viewer) managed as a uv workspace — unusual for a single-repo web service. 2. Playwright/Chromium bundled in the Docker image (~300-500 MB) for SVG-to-PNG rendering via a headless browser at request time. 3. The repo is explicitly described as 'guardrail-first boilerplate' with the generation pipeline intentionally deferred — meaning core business logic (the actual question generation algorithm) is stub/scaffold, not production-complete. 4. A .beads/ directory (organisational memory/issue tracking tool) and extensive .claude/ agent tooling are checked into the repo alongside application code.
